one_line: Nvidia faces a major leadership transition following CEO Jensen Huang's resignation, while funding rounds and infrastructure developments continue across the AI industry.

themes.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns
themes.text: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as CEO following an investigation into personal relationships, with CFO Colette Kress taking over as interim chief. The departure prompted market concerns, investor calls for a measured succession, and congressional inquiries into past chip sales and export policies.

themes.title: Data platform and chip startups raise funds
themes.text: Databento secured a $100 million Series C round at a $1.1 billion valuation, and Nebuly raised $21 million to measure enterprise AI agent ROI. Meanwhile, TSMC plans a $500 million fund to invest in chip startups and suppliers.

themes.title: New benchmark tracks AI saturation
themes.text: Ethan Mollick created SatBench and found that 63% of major AI benchmarks cited by labs since 2023 are now saturated. He also reported on research traffic generated by agent swarms and used Claude Fable 5.2 to reconstruct an obscure poetry class.
